text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 137 पर पत्तियों वाली कविता पढ़ो, फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 137 par pattiyon waali kavita padho, phir jawab do.
text.en: Read the poem about the leaves on page 137 of your book, then answer.

steps.question: What did the leaves say in the spring?

questionMeaning.hi: बसंत में पत्तियों ने क्या कहा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Basant mein pattiyon ne kya kaha?

options: It's spring; here we are, opening and stretching on every tree.
steps.answer: It's spring; here we are, opening and stretching on every tree.

steps.question: In which season do birds make nests in the trees?

questionMeaning.hi: चिड़ियाँ किस मौसम में घोंसले बनाती हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Chidiyaan kis mausam mein ghonsle banaati hain?

steps.question: What did the leaves say in the autumn?

questionMeaning.hi: पतझड़ में पत्तियों ने क्या कहा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Patjhad mein pattiyon ne kya kaha?

steps.modelAnswer: In autumn the leaves said, ‘It's autumn, aren't we all gay?’ They were scarlet, golden and russet.

modelMeaning.hi: पतझड़ में पत्तियों ने कहा, ‘पतझड़ है, क्या हम सब रंगीन नहीं?’ वे लाल, सुनहरी और भूरी थीं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Patjhad mein pattiyon ne kaha, ‘Patjhad hai, kya hum sab rangeen nahi?’ Woh laal, sunahri aur bhoori thin.

steps.question: What happened to the leaves in the winter?

questionMeaning.hi: सर्दी में पत्तियों का क्या हुआ?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Sardi mein pattiyon ka kya hua?

options: They were weary, so they lay down and slept under the tree.
steps.answer: They were weary, so they lay down and slept under the tree.
